summary: Alpine Income Property Trust, via a wholly owned subsidiary of its operating partnership, filed an 8-K disclosing an October 5, 2026 Purchase and Sale Agreement with an unaffiliated institutional seller to acquire a 13-property industrial portfolio spanning 11 states for $117.3 million, subject to closing prorations. The $1.0 million earnest money became non-refundable on October 9, 2026, and the company now deems closing probable though conditions remain unsatisfied. No board recommendation or advisor is named, and no financing terms are disclosed. Watch closing conditions, financing and cap-rate disclosure on the pro formas.
